tonight.title: The Odyssey
tonight.why: Tonight, cast aside your mundane reality and plunge into the ultimate epic with 'The Odyssey,' where Odysseus's harrowing journey home from Troy is a masterclass in mythological mayhem and enduring human spirit. It's a timeless tale of gods, monsters, and a hero's unbreakable will, perfect for a grand escape.

releases.title: Avengers: Doomsday
releases.take: Three universes collide, proving that even beloved heroes can't avoid the ultimate interdimensional traffic jam.

releases.title: Steps
releases.take: This stepsister's magical mishap confirms that even a royal ball can't escape a good old-fashioned froggy disaster.

releases.title: The Beast
releases.take: When the President's limo becomes a weaponized tank, you know D.C. traffic is about to get a whole lot more explosive.

critic.title: Steps
critic.blurb: 'The Beast' is a glorious, unapologetic ride into high-octane absurdity, where presidential security means turning a limousine into a mobile fortress of pure destruction. It's not just a thrill ride; it's a wonderfully over-the-top power fantasy that dares to ask: what if the Secret Service had a rocket launcher?
